name: ReadWrite

sources.title: ReadWrite Submission Manager (Submittable) — currently no open calls
Third-party guide describing ReadWrite guest vs expert contributor routes
Third-party guide on pitching ReadWrite editorially

conditions: Free guest-contributor pitches go through editorial review only when a call for submissions is open; the Submittable portal showed no open calls at retrieval time
A paid 'expert contributor' route (annual fee) with faster review has been described by third parties
requirements: ReadWrite is now an editorial publication (tech/gaming/iGaming focus), not a directory — there is no self-serve listing
Contributions must be expert-led, data-rich articles; shallow promotional pitches are rejected
Byline credibility matters: pitch as a practitioner with a concrete angle tied to their current coverage
preparation: A specific article pitch or draft (roughly 800-1,500 words per third-party guidance) with data or exclusive insight
Author bio and credentials establishing expertise
Suggested visuals (charts/infographics) to strengthen the pitch
workflow: Check https://readwriteweb.submittable.com/submit for an open call for submissions
If a call is open, submit the pitch/draft through the Submittable form
If no call is open, pitch directly via editorial contact (tips@readwrite.com / editorial@readwrite.com per third-party directories — unverified)
For the paid route, inquire about the expert contributor program via the site's contact/advertise channels
watchFor: Submittable showed 'no open calls for submissions' — the free route may be closed indefinitely
Direct-email addresses come from third-party write-ups, not the site itself — verify before relying on them
ReadWrite's current focus leans toward gaming/betting content; a B2B SaaS pitch may not fit
Do not submit promotional product-announcement copy; it will be rejected
countsAsLive: A published article on readwrite.com carrying your byline or citing your product with a link
unknowns: Whether the free contributor program is currently accepting pitches at all
Current price of the expert contributor annual fee
Whether tips@/editorial@ addresses are still monitored
Whether links in contributed articles are dofollow
